ground: Six approved ground PNGs copied unchanged; appear instantly, independently of coral growth.
palette: Salmon bodies have turquoise tips; turquoise bodies have salmon tips; alpha and geometry are identical.

landmark.rim: Sculpted lip in the body artwork, not an enlarged ordinary connection stroke.
landmark.eligibility: Every same-color occupied 2x2, including overlapping circles and circles formed over multiple placements.
landmark.orientation: Keep the body orientation stable when later neighbors are added.
landmark.anemones: Immediate orthogonal neighboring colonies develop one joint anemone.

anemone.excluded: Diagonal colony offsets, corner-only contacts, separated or opposite-colored colonies.
anemone.count: One per immediate horizontal/vertical neighboring colony pair; no joins across intervening colonies.
anemone.position: Midpoint of colony centers. Vertical artwork for horizontally adjacent colonies; rotate 90 degrees for vertically adjacent colonies.
anemone.regions: Eight reveal partitions use the same crown geodesic mask and timeline; they are not separate anatomical tentacle animations.
anemone.center_policy: Warm oral disc retained in both variants; reciprocal tentacle accents differ.
anemone.three_by_three: Four overlapping 2x2 colonies, four anemones, no central or diagonal anemone.

status: Ready for integration; Godot and Android verification pending

growth_contract.source: Accepted logical placement; no changes to move legality, symmetry, controls, helper budgets or Place-button gate.
growth_contract.ground: Show immediately on occupied cells; no growth mask or animation.
growth_contract.mask_decode: 8-bit grayscale linear data, u=red/255; not source_color.
growth_contract.arrival: min(enabled0 ? start0+u*duration : INF, enabled1 ? start1+(1-u)*duration : INF)
growth_contract.completion: Force full original artwork only after every visible pixel has finished; keep node and stop active updates.
growth_contract.existing_sources: Multi-source Dijkstra over new-new and new-existing same-color orthogonal center edges, 0.20 seconds per cell. Existing completed source centers start at 0.
growth_contract.half_arm_fronts: For A->B, start0=t_center[A], start1=t_center[B]+0.10, duration=0.10. Both enabled; earlier front wins.
growth_contract.no_external_source: All new cells bud at t=0; internal half-arms use start0=0.10, start1=0.20, duration=0.10. No outward arms at empty/opposite-color edges.
growth_contract.branching: All newly required arms can propagate once their center is reached; details follow attachment dependencies.
growth_contract.circle: All eight ordinary half-arms on a same-color 2x2 perimeter must be visibly complete; then grow colony_body from the existing 77px-thick circle. Overlapping circles are allowed.
growth_contract.anemone: Wait for both supporting immediate-neighbor colony component sets to develop. Foot then oral disc then shared-clock crown growth.
growth_contract.stable_keys: (color,cell,component), (color,colony_origin,component), (color,sorted_immediate_colony_pair,component). Preserve completed nodes and feature creation order.
growth_contract.painter_order: Arms 10, junction fills 11, cores 20, fingers 30. Colony containers in creation order, body/folds/fingers within each. Anemones above colonies, foot/regions/disc within each.
growth_contract.undo_delete: Receive restored authoritative board. Invalidate stale callbacks, remove invalid component/colony/pair keys only, preserve surviving artwork. Restore saved visual state if supplied; otherwise settle surviving target. Ground follows occupancy.
growth_contract.reset_theme_switch: Invalidate callbacks, clear old theme registries, derive target from actual board. Theme switch may build the current board fully complete; never alter its logical colors or symmetry.
growth_contract.interruption: Follow project-owned animation/gate policy; no imposed settle-on-next-placement behavior. Use explicit settle/cancel hooks only when requested by the project.
growth_contract.current_growth_rule: Four colonies/four anemones in 3x3; three colonies/two anemones in filled 4x2 or 2x4.
growth_contract.active_existing_source: If a logical source is still growing, borrow its predicted visible center/edge arrival from the existing visual timeline. Do not treat invisible artwork as complete, do not seed locally when a logical same-color orthogonal source exists, and do not force it to finish merely because another placement arrives.

rendering.sampling: Linear, clamp, lossless. Disable mipmaps for exact ground port profile compatibility; GPU mipmapped seams not verified.
rendering.art_alpha: Straight RGBA; ground opaque over full occupied cell, other artwork transparent.
rendering.active_materials: Independent mutable ShaderMaterial per component; share immutable textures and Shader.
rendering.clock: CPU clock controlled by project pause/cancel policy, not shader TIME.

rotation_convention.sprite_rotation: about fixed pivot; rotate artwork and growth mask together
rotation_convention.core: Preserve core orientation once created; use the supplied directional components to add connections.

ground_selection.algorithm: h=((x*73856093) XOR (y*19349663) XOR 1409) masked to 32 bits; component=ground_components[h%6]; rotation_quarters=(h>>8)%4

source_artwork_creator: OpenAI image generation, directed and approved by the user; technical assembly by Codex
ordinary_center_rule: Use the ordinary core at the existing starting occupied cell; preserve project-owned logical color assignment.

audio.status: Draft audition; listening balance and Godot/Android verification pending

ordinary_growth.stop: last ordinary component in placement completes or is canceled
ordinary_growth.scope: one texture per active placement, never one per cell or arm
ordinary_growth.selection: stable placement ID modulo 3; do not use logical color

colony.trigger: colony foundation visibly begins after its cycle completes

anemone.trigger: anemone foot visibly begins after supporting colonies become ready

mix.scope: same event type in the same placement
mix.simultaneous_colony_and_anemone: both eligible; features bus cap 2 voices, prioritize anemone if full
mix.selection: stable feature key hash; no immediate repeat when alternatives exist
mix.pan: centered; shared mix for both logical colors

lifecycle.undo_delete: cancel invalid event IDs, fade active growth in 80ms; never replay survivors
lifecycle.reset_theme_switch: cancel pending events, fade active SFX 80ms and ambience 600ms
lifecycle.save_load: start ambience; render settled board silently
lifecycle.pause: pause visual clock and audio together; do not advance cue clocks
lifecycle.rules: audio follows visual callbacks and never changes occupancy, symmetry, controls or placement gates
